# Invoice Template

> Invoice Template is a free Chrome extension for creating professional invoices. No registration required, works offline, and exports invoices to PDF.

Key facts (from https://invoice-templates-now.com/):

- Platform: Google Chrome extension
- Price: free
- Works completely offline; data stays on the user's device (no cloud storage, no registration)
- Customizable invoice templates with business branding
- Client management: store client information, track invoice status, maintain payment records
- Support for 100+ currencies
- PDF export for sharing and printing

## Links

- [Homepage](https://invoice-templates-now.com/): Overview of features
- [Install from Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/invoice-template/jiephbmepjaibnflchgedmkhefidahhj): Official listing and install page
- [Installation guide](https://invoice-templates-now.com/install.html): How to pin the extension to the Chrome toolbar after installing
